candidateOccurrences.sourceText: We have shot at them. Heshbon has perished even to Dibon. We have laid waste even to Nophah, Which reaches to Medeba.”
candidateOccurrences.previousContext: Woe to you, Moab! You are undone, people of Chemosh! He has given his sons as fugitives, and his daughters into captivity, to Sihon king of the Amorites.
candidateOccurrences.nextContext: Thus Israel lived in the land of the Amorites.
